name: Nideng Ranye
source:
An experienced Arboranger who has a remarkably fashionable dressing style.

[spoiler]In reality, she's one of the chief executives of the organization "Light Pollution," who is extremely loyal to her leader.

She earned the trust of her teammates in Light Pollution. With strong endurance, she is known as "Unbeatable Nacrotia" and is capable of engaging in prolonged battles. However, she seems a bit gullible.[/spoiler]
